ports.note: Takes nothing and fetches nothing: it chooses where data will come from. Emits a satellite-product, its own port type, because a catalog search without a chosen product searches nothing.

ontology.note: The receipt states the route chosen and what was and was not read about it: what it measures, whether it is an observation or a model, sign-in, and the licence as read with where and when, or that it is unread. Held by fw:SatelliteProductChoiceShape. The routes are curated in JLT's EO Satellite Guide, whose eo: vocabulary is vendored in examples/eo and not yet loaded into the ontology.

changes.description: Choose the satellite product that measures a variable. Type a topic or a measurement, or pick one: the dialog shows the chain from question to collection, the caution about what a satellite measures, and one card per product, with what it measures and its unit, sign-in, the licence as read, whether a browser can read it and the quality rule. Products needing no sign-in come first. Adapted from JLT's EO Satellite Guide (MIT, commit 684833c), in Fieldwork's dialog style. Experiment 179.

evidence.note: The facts on each card were read in experiment 179's side experiments S3 to S8; a fact nobody read is shown as not read. Nothing here establishes that a product suits a health question, that its files hold data for a given place and date, or any citation: dataset citations are unread for every route.
